title: The Downside of Creating Good Habits
coreMove: Interrupt automatic competence with review so repetition keeps improving rather than concealing drift.
sourcePressure: Good habits create efficiency, but automatic repetition can hide mistakes, drift, and stagnation unless the person pauses to review and refine the routine deliberately.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Ending with a generic recap instead of showing how automaticity can hide mistakes.

hook: starting with a definition of automaticity
counterintuition: the problem is not motivation alone

exampleSpecs.domain: a seasoned paramedic reviewing routine handoffs after one missed allergy note
exampleSpecs.audience: a veteran who trusts automatic competence
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether review reveals drift hidden by speed
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he replays three handoffs and finds the skipped allergy question had become invisible
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an ambulance handoff card clipped to a jump bag

exampleSpecs.domain: a sushi chef filming knife cuts after years of automatic prep
exampleSpecs.audience: a skilled craftsperson whose speed masks imprecision
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether deliberate review turns routine into improvement again
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she slows the footage and sees the blade angle drift on every sixth cut
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a phone tripod aimed at a wet cutting board

exampleSpecs.domain: a customs officer auditing stamp decisions after the process feels effortless
exampleSpecs.audience: an officer whose fluency may hide pattern errors
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether automatic decisions need periodic inspection
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he samples twenty stamped forms and notices one country code he has been waving through too quickly
exampleSpecs.firstImage: passport stamps aligned beside a sample tray

exampleSpecs.domain: a ballet teacher revisiting barre basics after students plateau
exampleSpecs.audience: a teacher who has made warmups automatic

exampleSpecs.domain: a cybersecurity analyst reviewing an automated alert filter every quarter
exampleSpecs.audience: an analyst whose good system now hides misses
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether efficiency is checked for blind spots
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she opens the filter rules before renewing them and catches a new vendor domain being suppressed
exampleSpecs.firstImage: filter rules projected beside a quarterly review sheet

exampleSpecs.domain: a master gardener rotating pruning habits after old routines weaken fruit yield
exampleSpecs.audience: an expert whose reliable method has stopped fitting the trees
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether review updates a habit that once worked
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he compares last season cuts with fruiting spurs and changes the pruning sequence for the first time in years
exampleSpecs.firstImage: pruning cuts marked with colored twine on an apple branch

skillTargets: use review to refine a mature habit

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one automatic routine you are proud of and inspect the last three reps for one small drift you would miss on autopilot.
